verdict.rationale: Export applies to a project-management tool like Jira, but the evidence pack never documents an export feature, let alone one that keeps comments, attachments and audit trails. Mentions of 'Rich APIs' and REST queries are developer building blocks for building an export, not a full-history export capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a product manager, I know that exporting my workspace preserves full history—comments, attachments, and audit trails—not just task titles
